subject: Align availability: 60–90m ML infra deep-dive and agenda

Subject: Follow-up: discovery — deep-dive & next steps

Hi Sara,

Really appreciate the conversation earlier — great overview of ArgoHealth's forecast model use cases and infra constraints. Per our chat, the right next step is a focused ML/infra deep-dive (60–90 minutes) so our infra and runtime engineers can see your workload patterns and we can align on configuration, security, and rollout.

Proposed objectives:
- Walk through current model topology & serving pattern (RPS, seq len, cache hit expectations)
- Look at sample prompts/inputs and target latency/throughput SLOs
- Map out network/permissions needed for any PoC (whitelisted IPs, VPN, token scopes)
- Agree on success criteria and next steps (PoC timeline)

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue Jun 22 — 10:00–11:30
- Wed Jun 23 — 13:00–14:30
- Thu Jun 24 — 09:00–10:30

Attached is a short proposed agenda (redwood-tdx-proposed-agenda.pdf). If you prefer a 60-minute focused session instead of 90, we can tighten the walkthrough to key items.

Can you confirm which slot works, who from your side should join (ML infra, SRE, security), and whether you want us to prepare any network/credentials checklist ahead of time? Also call out any constraints (e.g., air-gapped environment, VPC-only access).

Next steps once we lock time: I will send a calendar invite with the detailed agenda and loop in Diego from our runtime team and Maya from solutions so we have the right folks.

Thanks,

Markus Klein

Subject: Prep items for 6/23 deep-dive (short checklist)

Thanks for looping me in — quick prep note from the runtime side. I'll keep this short so we can hand it to ArgoHealth as a pre-read.

Please confirm the following before the session if possible:
- Representative model artifact: name, architecture, and parameter count (or open-model equivalent)
- Typical sequence lengths (median and 95th pct) and tokenization details
- Peak RPS and typical burst patterns (e.g., 200 RPS sustained, 800 RPS bursts)
- Target latency SLOs (p50/p95 targets) and whether p99 matters for the PoC
- Example prompt(s) and a small sanitized batch (<=50 samples) we can use for profiling
- Endpoint access: will you provide a read-only URL + token, or do we stage a mirrored workload? If whitelisting IPs is easier, please share the allowed ranges

Operational items we'll cover in the session: kernel selection rationale, batching configuration, KV cache sizing, quantization trade-offs, and log/trace collection. If ArgoHealth can share any current perf traces that would materially speed the conversation.

I'm attaching a short Argo prep checklist (argo-poc-questions.xlsx) for easy completion; happy to take a quick 15-min pre-call if Tom wants to walk through it.

Diego Fernandez
